news.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
news.summary: The Mumbai-based exchange initially dismissed reports of suspicious outflows as a false alarm. It now says it lost $16 million and will absorb the loss.

news.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
news.summary: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

news.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
news.summary: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

news.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
news.summary: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.

news.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
news.summary: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

news.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
news.summary: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

news.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
news.summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

news.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
news.summary: Reactions split between amazement at how human it sounds and fears it could fuel scams and deception, with CZ eyeing uses in children’s education.

news.title: Musk says SpaceX landed a $40 billion debt deal — and forecasts doom for some AI rivals
news.summary: SpaceX is rapidly growing an AI business that rents out access to advanced chips.

news.title: ‘She’s living the dream’: My stepmother said I can buy my childhood home for $850,000. Is she taking advantage of me?
news.summary: “My late father bought our house for $250,000 in the 1990s.”

news.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
news.summary: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”

news.title: We stopped helping our neighbors with free home repairs and our friendship cooled. Who’s to blame?
news.summary: “Last summer, they complained about needing to replace their roof. A few months later, they bought a new SUV.”

news.title: My father-in-law, 81, sold his $75,000 home to pay his daughter’s $50,000 debt. How can I keep him from becoming destitute?
news.summary: “Nothing has been set aside for his needs.”

news.title: My partner of 17 years left me his $1 million home. His children are livid. Am I obliged to split it with them?
news.summary: “I never paid rent, although I put about $45,000 toward a new kitchen and a roof.”

news.title: We have a $300,000 mortgage with a 2.75% interest rate. I want to pay it off. My husband says I’m crazy. Who’s right?
news.summary: “I don’t want to enter retirement owing six figures when we have the cash to clear it.”
